takeaways: Many organizations pay twice by licensing E5 capabilities like Entra ID, Purview and Power Automate while also paying third-party vendors for the same functions.
Copilot only delivers returns on top of consolidated identity, clean data and consistent DLP; otherwise it exposes architectural debt.
Quarterly policy reviews, automated drift detection and a Center of Excellence prevent exceptions from eroding the control plane, while freed budget should be reinvested deliberately.
hook: Most Microsoft 365 tenants already contain more identity, governance and automation capability than the third-party tools organizations keep paying for. This episode helps IT leaders and architects find that overlap across Entra ID, Purview, Power Platform and Copilot, and turn the savings into a deliberate capital reallocation instead of another budget cut.
